name: tafensw.edu.au
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But buttons must have discernible text.
lesson: Give every button text or an aria-label, so a screen reader can announce it.
summary: www.tafensw.edu.au scores 74 out of 100 (C). 4 checks fail now, 30 are at risk, and 36 pass. Fix first: buttons must have discernible text.

fix.title: Buttons must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 6 elements on /, /contact-us, /international, for example .container.gap-2.w-full > .self-start.leading-none.ml-auto and .border-t > .gap-2.w-full.flex > .self-start.leading-none.ml-auto. Impact: critical.
fix.fix: Give each icon button visible text or an aria-label.

fix.title: 3 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /international, /shortlist. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Tracking starts on load and no banner asks first
fix.evidence: No cookie banner appeared. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Google Ads (5 requests), Google Analytics (4 requests), and cookies _gcl_au, _ga, _ga_HVPWRW2WHJ, test_cookie on doubleclick.net.
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: A window the page opens, or that opens it, keeps a handle to it, which tabnabbing and cross-site leaks use. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin-allow-popups, or same-origin when the site opens no sign-in or payment popup.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page arrived in 372 ms
Every page has a meta description
